title: Zoning Board of Appeals Public Hearing Notice -238 Munroe Hill Road
text: By Town Clerk at 12:09 pm, Oct 06, 2026 TOWN OF CARLISLE Zoning Board of Appeals 66 Westford Street Carlisle, MA 01741 978-369-9702 Public Hearing Notice In accordance with the provisions of MGL Chapter 40A Sections 10 and 11, notice is hereby given of a public hearing by the Carlisle Zoning Board of Appeals remotely on Zoom starting at 7:30 pm, November 2, 2026, for the application of Anthony Klauzinski requesting a Variance pursuant to Carlisle Zoning Bylaw Sections 4.3.2 and 7.5, for relief from the 40-foot setback requirement to allow construction of a detached garage. The property is located within the Residence B District at 238 Munroe Hill Road, Map 20, Parcel 69-23. A copy of the application, file number 2602, and any accompanying information may be viewed at the Planning Office located on the second floor of Town Hall, 66 Westford Street, during business hours Monday through Thursday, 8:30 am to 4:30 pm, and Friday, 9:00 am to 12:00 pm. Any person interested or wishing to be heard on the application should appear at the time and place designated or submit written correspondence to the Board of Appeals. Email correspondence should be sent to nbeland@carlislema.gov Noelle Beland, Planning and Land Use Coordinator Carlisle Zoning Board of Appeals

Public Continuation Hearing (In-Person Only) – Woodland Ridge 40B Comprehensive Permit/OpenGov Record No. COMP-25-2: An application has been submitted by Melissa Robbins (Farrell, & Robbins, P.C.), on behalf of Woodland Ridge, LLC., seeking a 40B Comprehensive Permit, pursuant to M.G.L. Chapter 40B, Sections 20-23, to develop a residential development on 45.5 acres of land located between Bancroft Street and Orion Road. The proposed development consists of forty (40) single-family homes, containing thirty-two (32) two-bedroom homes and eight (8) three-bedroom homes. The subject property is located at 24 Bancroft Street, Pepperell, MA, in the Town Residential (TR) District, in the ownership of Amanda P. and Theodore D. Filandrianos, as shown on Assessor's Map 33, Parcel 59-1, and further described by a Deed recorded at the Middlesex South District Registry of Deeds in Book 49686, Page 154. title: Wellfleet Selectboard Public Lottery Notice
text: WELLFLEET SELECTBOARD PUBLIC LOTTERY NOTICE ANNOUNCEMENT OF AVAILABILITY OF SHELLFISH AQUACULTURE GRANT LICENSE NUMBER: 2001-07 The Town of Wellfleet Shellfish Department and Selectboard announce the availability of shellfish grant license # 2001-07 (0.8 acres), located on Lieutenant Island on Mass Audubon Wellfleet Bay Wildlife Sanctuary Property. This site is generally sandy-bottomed and high and is frequently exposed for rather long periods of time. Shifting sands may be a limiting factor in quahog culture. Access to this grant is by foot only. Boat access is also possible. In accordance with MGL Chapter 130 Sections 52, 57, 58, 59, 60, and 62, and Section 7.2. Previously Established Grants that Become Available in the Town of Wellfleet’s Shellfishing Policy and Regulations and all other applicable town shellfish regulations, notice is hereby given that the Wellfleet Selectboard will hold a hybrid public hearing Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. to conduct a lottery for the above-mentioned shellfish grant. The application period opens September 24, 2026, for 30 days. The Shellfish Department will have applications printed out and available at their office at the pier. Applications will also be available to download from the Town of Wellfleet website. Applications and the required supporting documentation must be delivered to Shellfish Constable Nancy Civetta directly or emailed to Nancy.civetta@wellfleetma.gov by the deadline of Friday, October 23, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. No exceptions will be made. For eligibility criteria, please visit: https://www.wellfleet-ma.gov/DocumentCenter/View/5754/Shellfishing-Policy-and-Regulationsupdated-7-7-26 and see Section 7.8.1. Eligibility Requirements on page 24. Wellfleet Selectboard Public Lottery for Aquaculture Grant #2001-7: November 4, 2026, 6:00 p.m. In person: 715 Old King’s Highway (Adult Community Center) Join Zoom Meeting: https://uso2web.zoom.us/j/87590975906 By Phone: +1 929 205 6099 and enter Webinar ID: 875 9097 5906 \ Passcode:904764 WELLFLEET SELECTBOARD
